searchAudit.objective: Discover fresh, executable blind-spot candidates for cooperative autonomous driving that do not require an uninstalled heavyweight protocol stack and can reach a go/no-go decision with public code, data, and checkpoints within two weeks.

rulesApplied.assetPolicy: A repository or download link was not treated as an executable asset until its current state, a fixed commit, or official hosted metadata was inspected.
rulesApplied.defectClaimPolicy: No dataset defect is asserted. Unread or oversized assets are reported as unverified or infeasible, not defective.

sourceAttempts.note: Existing cooperative candidate ledgers and audits were read to freeze rejected, blocked, and active mechanisms. They were not used as verification evidence.
Abstract pages were used for contribution, dataset, and release claims; code claims were cross-checked against official repositories where relevant.
CVF, ACM, USENIX, IEEE-linked, and Nature pages were preferred over secondary summaries.

Project pages were used to verify task scope and public entry points, not to replace paper evidence.
Repositories and Hugging Face trees are recorded in assetChecks rather than double-counted as papers.

limitations: No full V2U4Real or V2X-Radar payload was downloaded because official hosted metadata shows that the releases are approximately 95.2 GB and 97.6 GB respectively, with no verified lightweight mini split.
A Google Drive checkpoint link in CoSDH was inspected as a link in the fixed repository README; checkpoint bytes and hashes were not independently downloaded or verified.

MDrive source and scenario metadata were inspected, but CARLA and planner environments were not installed or executed because that path violates the lightweight two-week entry constraint for this discovery pass.
The anonymous Selective Language Communication submission is primary evidence of an observed failure mode, but its review outcome and public code/checkpoint state remain unresolved.

verifiedReferences.title: Selective Language Communication for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Reports on V2V4Real that blind feature fusion improves receiver-invisible objects by 7.9 percentage points while degrading receiver-visible objects by 7.9 points, and proposes communication restricted to what the receiver cannot see.

verifiedReferences.title: BOLT: Online Lightweight Adaptation for Preparation-Free Heterogeneous Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Finds that preparation-free direct heterogeneous fusion can greatly underperform ego-only perception and introduces a 0.9M-parameter online ego-as-teacher adapter with official code.

verifiedReferences.title: Safety-Aligned 3D Object Detection: Single-Vehicle, Cooperative, and End-to-End Perspectives
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Shows that mAP or NDS gains need not align with safety criteria, evaluates cooperative detection ego-centrically, and integrates EC-IoU into SparseDrive with a reported collision-rate reduction.

verifiedReferences.title: MDrive: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Cooperative Driving for End-to-End Multi-agent Systems
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Introduces 225 closed-loop scenarios and evaluates both perception sharing and decision negotiation, including cases where improved perception does not improve planning and negotiation can hurt in complex traffic.

verifiedReferences.title: Defer to Plan: Adaptive Multi-Agent Fusion for End-to-End V2X Driving
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Optimizes adaptive multi-agent fusion for the downstream planning objective rather than treating perception fusion as an isolated target.

verifiedReferences.title: Select2Drive: Enhancing Real-World V2X Autonomous Driving with Pragmatic Communications
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Uses planning-relevant areas of importance for communication and explicitly motivates selection because broad shared information can confuse decision making.

verifiedReferences.title: V2U4Real: A Real-world Large-scale Dataset for Vehicle-to-UAV Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides real vehicle-UAV LiDAR and camera data with more than 56K LiDAR frames, 56K images, 700K boxes, and detection plus tracking benchmarks.

verifiedReferences.title: V2X-Radar: A Multi-modal Dataset with 4D Radar for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides real vehicle-infrastructure 4D radar, LiDAR, and camera data across sunny, rainy, daytime, dusk, and nighttime conditions.

verifiedReferences.title: TraF-Align: Trajectory-aware Feature Alignment for Asynchronous Multi-agent Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Addresses asynchronous feature alignment with trajectory-aware compensation and reports evaluation on public cooperative-perception benchmarks.

verifiedReferences.title: CATNet: Collaborative Alignment and Transformation Network for Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Jointly addresses temporal latency and multi-source noise through collaborative alignment and transformation.

verifiedReferences.title: STCC: Spatiotemporal Co-Sensing Calibration for Robust Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Addresses spatiotemporal calibration under variable delay and prediction, directly narrowing generic joint pose-delay correction candidates.

verifiedReferences.title: mmCooper: A Multi-agent Multi-stage Communication-efficient and Collaboration-robust Cooperative Perception Framework
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Targets communication efficiency and robustness across multiple communication stages and agent conditions.

verifiedReferences.title: CoST: Efficient Collaborative Perception From Unified Spatiotemporal Perspective
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Unifies spatial and temporal processing for efficient collaborative perception, directly narrowing generic spatiotemporal-fusion gaps.

verifiedReferences.title: FocalComm: Hard Instance-Aware Multi-Agent Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Selects communication around hard instances, covering broad receiver-need and low-confidence routing formulations.

verifiedReferences.title: INTACT: Ego-Guided Typed Sparse Evidence Retrieval for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Uses ego-guided typed sparse evidence retrieval for heterogeneous collaboration, narrowing receiver-driven and cross-model candidate space.

verifiedReferences.title: V2XPnP: Vehicle-to-Everything Spatio-Temporal Fusion for Multi-Agent Perception and Prediction
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Jointly evaluates cooperative perception and prediction with spatiotemporal fusion.

verifiedReferences.title: Co-MTP: A Cooperative Trajectory Prediction Framework with Multi-Temporal Fusion for Autonomous Driving
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides a cooperative trajectory-prediction framework and official project page for multi-temporal fusion.

verifiedReferences.title: CoLMDriver: LLM-based Negotiation Benefits Cooperative Autonomous Driving
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Implements cooperative driving negotiation with an LLM-based decision component and is a released MDrive baseline.

verifiedReferences.title: V2X-ReaLO: An Open Online Framework and Dataset for Cooperative Perception in Reality
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Describes an online real-world cooperative-perception framework and reports a 25,028-frame test set, while the abstract states release intent rather than proving a complete checkpoint release.

verifiedReferences.title: CooperScene: Multi-Modal Cooperative Autonomy Benchmark with C-V2X Communication Characterization
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Combines multimodal cooperative autonomy with measured C-V2X communication characterization, relevant to natural network evidence.

verifiedReferences.title: A Deployed Hybrid Vehicle-in-the-Loop Platform for Validating Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides a deployed hybrid vehicle-in-the-loop validation setting for cooperative perception.

verifiedReferences.title: CADET: A Modular Platform for Evaluating Distributed Cooperative Autonomy in Connected Autonomous Vehicles
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Offers a modular platform for distributed cooperative-autonomy evaluation, but platform integration remains heavier than a small checkpoint replay.

verifiedReferences.title: Boosting Collaborative Vehicular Perception on the Edge with Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Studies collaborative vehicular perception under edge and V2V communication constraints.

verifiedReferences.title: Latency Robust Cooperative Perception using Asynchronous Feature Fusion
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides an asynchronous feature-fusion method and an official code link, directly covering generic latency-robust fusion.

verifiedReferences.title: R-ACP: Real-Time Adaptive Collaborative Perception Leveraging Robust Task-Oriented Communications
verifiedReferences.venue: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Combines calibration, freshness, robust feature filtering, and task-oriented communications.

verifiedReferences.title: SEE-V2X: C-V2X Direct Communication Dataset: An Application-Centric Approach
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides an official application-centric C-V2X direct-communication dataset entry point for natural network traces.

verifiedReferences.title: COOPERTRIM: Adaptive Data Selection for Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Uses temporal uncertainty for adaptive feature selection, making uncertainty-only missingness wrappers non-novel for this pass.

verifiedReferences.title: CoInfra: A Large-Scale Cooperative Infrastructure Perception System and Dataset for Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperation in Adverse Weather
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides adverse-weather vehicle-infrastructure cooperative data and an official code repository.

verifiedReferences.title: CellReplay: Towards Accurate Record-and-Replay for Cellular Networks
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides primary evidence and tooling for high-fidelity cellular record-and-replay, but not a cooperative-driving checkpoint pipeline by itself.

verifiedReferences.title: CascadeNet: Generating Network Traffic with High-Fidelity Temporal Patterns
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Studies generation of network traffic with temporal fidelity; it is supporting systems evidence rather than a cooperative-driving contribution.

verifiedReferences.title: Bridging the Latency Gap with a Continuous Stream Evaluation Framework in Event-Driven Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Demonstrates that continuous-stream latency evaluation can expose behavior hidden by frame-based evaluation, but is not specific to cooperative driving.

verifiedReferences.title: Camera Health-Aware Cooperative Perception via Controlled Degradation and Uncertainty-Based Reliability
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Directly studies degraded cooperative cameras through controlled corruption and uncertainty-based reliability, but is non-archival and squarely an uncertainty wrapper.

verifiedReferences.title: CoSDH: Communication-Efficient Collaborative Perception via Supply-Demand Awareness and Intermediate-Late Hybridization
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides supply-demand communication and intermediate-late hybrid fusion with official code and a linked checkpoint folder.

verifiedReferences.title: V2X-DG: Domain Generalization for Multi-Agent Collaborative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Evaluates domain generalization across OPV2V, V2XSet, V2V4Real, and DAIR-V2X, narrowing cross-dataset heterogeneity gaps.

verifiedReferences.title: V2X-Real: A Large-Scale Dataset for Vehicle-to-Everything Cooperative Perception
verifiedReferences.primaryEvidence: Provides a real four-agent multimodal cooperative-perception dataset with more than one million annotated boxes.

candidateLedger.title: Receiver-visible object non-regression under cooperative fusion
candidateLedger.hypothesis: A receiver-side admission rule can preserve ego-visible detections while accepting collaborator evidence only for ego-invisible objects, yielding hidden-object gains without visible-object regression.
candidateLedger.naturalEvidence: Selective Language Communication reports an exact V2V4Real sign split: blind fusion gains 7.9 points on invisible objects and loses 7.9 points on visible objects.

nearestWorkComparison.candidate: Receiver-visible versus receiver-invisible ground-truth objects.
nearestWorkComparison.nearestWork: Selective Language Communication uses this same visibility partition on V2V4Real.
nearestWorkComparison.remainingGap: None at the problem-definition level.

nearestWorkComparison.candidate: Reject collaborator evidence for already visible objects.
nearestWorkComparison.nearestWork: Selective Language Communication communicates only what the receiver cannot see; BOLT also uses ego confidence to guide where neighbors contribute.
nearestWorkComparison.remainingGap: A different gate implementation would be an implementation variant, not a fresh blind spot.

nearestWorkComparison.candidate: Non-regression on visible-object accuracy plus gain on hidden objects.
nearestWorkComparison.nearestWork: The anonymous submission reports exactly these subgroup outcomes.
nearestWorkComparison.remainingGap: Directly covered.

conclusion.summary: None of the 12 canonical candidates simultaneously has primary natural or data evidence for the exact failure, a gap not directly occupied by the nearest 2024-2026 work, verified official code plus data plus checkpoint, a CPU/single-GPU small-sample closure path, and useful positive and negative outcomes.
conclusion.decisionRule: A candidate was shortlisted only if every mandatory gate passed. No score was computed and no acceptance threshold was inferred.
dominantEliminationReasons: Direct coverage by Selective Language Communication, BOLT, MDrive, Defer to Plan, Select2Drive, Safety-Aligned Detection, or recent spatiotemporal alignment work.
Natural evidence existed for the broad domain but not for the candidate's exact failure mechanism.
Official releases lacked a verified compact split or exact checkpoint payload for a two-week lightweight closure.
The remaining output would be benchmark audit, field/accounting validation, or a generic fallback mechanism.
